author: More Perfect Union
description:
AI companies are gearing up to spend over $100 million on the 2026 elections.

In one North Carolina district they already dropped more than half a million dollars on one primary ad.

They're trying to take down Bernie-backed Nida Allam, and boost a candidate who will give them free reign.
title: Nida Allam is taking on AI data centers. Big Tech is terrified.
